name: issei-plugin
description: Issei's personal Claude Code setup - twenty-four skills. Vault skills (search-vault, research-vault, challenge-vault, distil-vault, lint-vault, weekly-vault-review). Pipeline / cadence (harvest - weekly knowledge-base harvest with co-located Python scripts; standup-update - daily standup from Claude Code sessions plus GitHub PRs). Voice / doc (issei-voice for short-form chat, blog-voice for long-form technical writing, exec-summary for condensing spikes and PoCs into tight outcome docs). Review / sprint (turbo-pr-review - lightweight human-in-the-loop PR walkthrough, lighter than intech-tools:code-review; pr-review-loop - autonomous scheduled CDT PR review deferring approval + merge to a human; sprint-review-retro; sprint-demo-slide; jira-board-hygiene - surfaces own-board drift and suggests moves, applied only on confirmation). Autopilot - presence, memory, and execution (working-memory - cross-session per-branch state; morning-brief - day assembly; presence-triage - the Teams/Outlook cockpit; context-assemble - the context-router fanning out Jira/GitHub/Confluence/vault/working-memory into one ranked bundle; ticket-dispatch - the execution loop taking a Jira ticket to a reviewable draft PR through two hard human gates, never auto-merging; scoro-timesheet - fill the Scoro timesheet, never submit). Plus meeting-agenda and aws-saa-revision (interactive AWS SAA drilling). No MCP, no hooks, no agents. Most fire on intent; any is invocable by name. The Autopilot skills call scripts + a dedicated local automation browser that live in the separate project-autopilot repo. drawio-diagrams and skill-creator dropped in 0.3.0; covered by the team plugin.
